title: Lac de la Cula
description: Nestled in a small depression, protected from the wind, Lac de la Cula is a quiet, little-frequented spot.

src: photos/2023-10-17 15h39m09s Still water of Lac de la Cula.jpeg
title: Still water of Lac de la Cula
description:
Long exposure is a well-known technique that has been used since the early days of photography.

As well as adding light, long exposure also creates special effects by changing the way we normally see things that move.

This 2-minute long exposure smoothes out the ripples on the surface of the lake.

src: photos/2023-10-17 16h02m55s Dry branchs of dwarf juniper.jpeg
title: Dry branchs of dwarf juniper
description: This is the dwarf subspecies of the common juniper, found at altitude on rocky outcrops and mountain meadows. This recumbent shrub forms dense mats at ground level. This feature enables it to resist wind, but also to benefit from the protection of snow (which insulates and protects against frost) in winter.
